# Sample PDFs

The test set from SRS 9.1 (#12). Every file is generated by `src-tauri/src/fixtures.rs` from made-up text, so none holds personal or client data. Run `npm run fixtures` to write them again after changing the generator; `the_committed_files_match_the_generator` fails until you do.

The integration tests in `fixtures.rs` open, split and export each file with the bundled presets, check every part, and check that the original file is unchanged (FR-04).

| File | Pages | What it tests | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textbook-bookmarks.pdf` | 14 | Textbook with bookmarks, sections under chapters | 4 parts, one per chapter |
| `course-notes-single-root.pdf` | 9 | One top-level bookmark wrapping the chapters (#73) | 3 parts, one per week |
| `field-guide-nested.pdf` | 7 | Chapters two levels under a single bookmark (#73) | 4 parts |
| `invoice-batch.pdf` | 7 | Invoice batch, invoice number pattern | 4 parts |
| `encrypted-invoices.pdf` | 7 | The invoice batch, encrypted (password `fixture-password`) | Asks for the password, then 4 parts |
| `bank-statements.pdf` | 5 | Account number pattern | 3 parts |
| `employee-records.pdf` | 4 | Employee ID pattern | 3 parts |
| `insurance-claims.pdf` | 5 | Claim number pattern | 3 parts |
| `bills-of-lading.pdf` | 3 | Bill of lading pattern | 2 parts |
| `blank-separators.pdf` | 7 | Letters separated by blank pages | 3 parts with separators dropped, 5 with them kept |
| `textbook-no-bookmarks.pdf` | 14 | Textbook without bookmarks | Falls back to the AI |
| `contract-bundle.pdf` | 6 | Contract bundle, an AI preset | Needs the AI |
| `scanned-pages.pdf` | 4 | Pages with a picture and no text layer | "No text layer" error |
| `corrupt.pdf` | | A cut-off file | "Damaged or is not a PDF" error |

The 1,000-page file is not committed. The tests build it in a temp folder, and `npm run fixtures` also writes it to `generated/`, which git ignores.
